title: Spend Credit Schedule on the Tailwise Plus Annual First Term
content:
**Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus.** When a customer on a free tier buys Tailwise Plus Annual, a spend credit — a flat dollar amount — is subtracted from the first-term Plus Annual fee according to the membership's net qualifying spend over the last 12 months: the qualifying spend of its points-earning entries dated in the last 12 months, less the qualifying spend of its points-reversal entries dated in the same period.

| Net qualifying spend over the last 12 months | Spend credit |
|---|---|
| $1500.00 or more | $5.00 |
| $800.00 or more, below $1500.00 | $2.50 |
| below $800.00 | none |

**Both sides (hypothetical spend).** $799.99: none; $800.00: $2.50; $1499.99: $2.50; $1500.00: $5.00.

**Netting (hypothetical).** Earnings of $1,620.00 and reversals of $140.00 give $1,480.00: $2.50.
